---
title: "Most draft-eligible college seasons end without an NFL outcome"
date: "2026-10-24"
description: "Only 3.6% of draft-eligible college player-seasons end in a draft selection and 8.3% in NFL entry, more entrants arrive undrafted than drafted, the per-season entry chance rises from 4.1% to 20.4% by the fourth eligible season, and the drafted share fell from 5.9% (2012 class) to 2.6% (2025)."
followups:
  - "Evaluate out-of-time models with calibration metrics, since the positive class is rarer in later draft classes than in training data."
  - "Include the eligible-season index as a model term; the entry hazard varies fourfold across it."
  - "Treat made-roster and rookie-games as a separate second-stage prediction problem, not a footnote on entry."
author:
  - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Most draft-eligible college seasons end without an NFL outcome}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# Wilson interval for a binomial proportion.
wilson <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  p <- x / n
  d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  c <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d
  h <- (z / d) * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))
  c(lo = pmax(0, c - h), hi = pmin(1, c + h))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
outcomes <- tbl(con, "outcomes") |> collect()
dbDisconnect(con)

risk <- outcomes |>
  filter(draft_eligible, outcome_observed_d) |>
  mutate(
    outcome_signed_udfa_d = coalesce(outcome_signed_udfa_d, FALSE),
    outcome_drafted_d = coalesce(outcome_drafted_d, FALSE),
    outcome_nfl_entry_d = coalesce(outcome_nfl_entry_d, FALSE)
  )

n_risk <- nrow(risk)
n_players <- n_distinct(risk$playerId)
# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-24. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are administratively right-censored and carry
no outcomes, so they are excluded from every rate below rather than counted
as failures.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

A model that forecasts who reaches the NFL has to beat the trivial forecast
that nobody does, which is right for
`r pct(1 - mean(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d))` of draft-eligible college
seasons, so this post measures that base rate and its parts, with Joe
Burrow, Cam Ward, Jordan Travis, Shane Buechele, and Kyle Allen as running
examples.

+ *Expecting the draft to be rare, under five percent of eligible seasons.*
+ *Expecting undrafted free-agent entry to rival the draft as an NFL route.*
+ *Expecting exhausted eligibility to be the most common end-of-season
  status.*
+ *Expecting the chance of NFL entry to rise over a player's eligible
  seasons.*
+ *Expecting NFL outcome prevalence to be roughly stable across draft
  classes.*
+ *Expecting most entrants to appear on an NFL roster in their entry year.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Every eligible season ends in exactly one of five statuses

A **player-season** is one player's college season with a recorded stat
line, **eligible** when the following draft comes at least three years after
his high-school graduation; the table defines the five ways an eligible
season can end.

```{r}
#| label: status-terms
status_terms <- tribble(
  ~Status                             , ~`NFL entry` , ~Definition                                                                                                                                                                            ,
  "Drafted"                           , "Yes"        , "Selected in the NFL draft held the spring after the season, reported by round: round 1, rounds 2 to 3, rounds 4 to 7."                                                                ,
  "Signed as an undrafted free agent" , "Yes"        , "Not selected in that draft, but on an NFL roster within the entry window afterward (matched by a guarded name lookup)."                                                               ,
  "Still playing next season"         , "No"         , "Back on a college roster the next season; the season is one more turn of the eligibility clock, not an outcome."                                                                      ,
  "Exhausted eligibility undrafted"   , "No"         , "The player's last observed college season, with no draft selection and no NFL roster appearance after it."                                                                            ,
  "Left the data early"               , "No"         , "Absent the next season although his record says a next season should exist (a transfer with sitting time, an injury retirement, or an unobserved departure); the outcome is unknown."
)
kable(
  status_terms,
  caption = "The five end-of-season statuses. NFL entry means drafted or signed as an undrafted free agent."
)
```

### 2.2 The risk set counts seasons, while each NFL event falls on one season per player

A player usually contributes several eligible seasons, so the table counts
more seasons than players, and each player's NFL entry, if any, falls on
exactly one of them.

```{r}
#| label: risk-set
risk_set <- tibble(
  Measure = c("Eligible player-seasons", "Distinct players"),
  Count = format(c(n_risk, n_players), big.mark = ",")
)
kable(
  risk_set,
  caption = "The risk set: eligible seasons with an observed outcome."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: grain-pin
#| include: false
# The draft and UDFA events are mutually exclusive, their union is the entry
# label on every row, and no player enters twice. A violation here would
# poison every rate below (a naive mean(na.rm = TRUE) over a partially NA flag
# once read UDFA prevalence at 35 percent instead of 4.7).
stopifnot(
  !any(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d),
  all(
    risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d ==
      (risk$outcome_drafted_d | risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
  ),
  !anyDuplicated(risk$playerId[risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d]),
  n_risk == 68993,
  n_players == 36223
)
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Fewer than four in every hundred eligible seasons end in a draft selection

```{r}
#| label: ledger-nums
#| include: false
p_drafted <- mean(risk$outcome_drafted_d)
p_udfa <- mean(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
p_entry <- mean(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d)
n_drafted <- sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d)
n_udfa <- sum(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d)
n_entry <- sum(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d)
ci_drafted <- wilson(n_drafted, n_risk)
```

*Expectation: the draft is rare, under five percent of eligible seasons.* ✅

Out of every 100 eligible seasons, `r fmt(100 * p_drafted, 1)` end drafted
and `r fmt(100 * p_entry, 1)` in NFL entry by either route; the table and
figures give each outcome with its 95 percent confidence interval, the range
the true rate plausibly occupies (Wilson's method), and split the draft by
round.

```{r}
#| label: ledger
ledger <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Outcome = c(
      "Drafted, any round",
      "  Drafted, round 1",
      "  Drafted, rounds 2 to 3",
      "  Drafted, rounds 4 to 7",
      "Signed as an undrafted free agent",
      "NFL entry (drafted or UDFA)"
    ),
    n_event = c(
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d),
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d == 1L),
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3),
      sum(risk$outcome_drafted_d & risk$outcome_draft_round_d >= 4L),
      sum(risk$outcome_signed_udfa_d),
      sum(risk$outcome_nfl_entry_d)
    )
  )
) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  transmute(
    Outcome,
    Events = format(n_event, big.mark = ","),
    `At risk` = format(n_risk, big.mark = ","),
    Prevalence = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_event / n_risk),
    `95% CI` = sprintf(
      "[%.1f%%, %.1f%%]",
      100 * wilson(n_event, n_risk)["lo"],
      100 * wilson(n_event, n_risk)["hi"]
    )
  )

kable(
  ledger,
  caption = "How often each outcome occurs among eligible player-seasons."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: ledger-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  p_drafted < 0.04,
  ci_drafted["hi"] < 0.05,
  n_drafted == 2479,
  n_udfa == 3239
)
```

```{r}
#| label: ledger-explain
#| fig-height: 5
ledger_plot <- tibble(
  Outcome = c(
    "Drafted, any round",
    "Signed as an undrafted free agent",
    "NFL entry (drafted or undrafted)"
  ),
  n_event = c(n_drafted, n_udfa, n_entry)
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    p = n_event / n_risk,
    lo = wilson(n_event, n_risk)["lo"],
    hi = wilson(n_event, n_risk)["hi"]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Outcome = reorder(Outcome, p),
    drafted = Outcome == "Drafted, any round"
  )
p_ledger <- ggplot(ledger_plot, aes(100 * p, Outcome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = drafted,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s of %s eligible seasons (%.1f%%, 95%% CI %.1f%% to %.1f%%)",
        Outcome,
        fmt(n_event),
        fmt(n_risk),
        100 * p,
        100 * lo,
        100 * hi
      ),
      data_id = Outcome
    ),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = 100 * lo, xmax = 100 * hi), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 100 * hi + 0.2, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * p)),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 5.1,
    y = 0.55,
    label = "5% line",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1B9E77", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "The draft takes fewer than four seasons in a hundred",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible player-seasons ending in each outcome",
    x = "Share of eligible seasons",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Whiskers: 95% confidence interval."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_ledger, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5)
```

### 3.2 More NFL entrants arrive undrafted than drafted

```{r}
#| label: routes
#| include: false
routes <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    route = case_when(
      !outcome_drafted_d ~ "Undrafted free agent",
      outcome_draft_round_d == 1L ~ "Drafted, round 1",
      outcome_draft_round_d %in% 2:3 ~ "Drafted, rounds 2 to 3",
      TRUE ~ "Drafted, rounds 4 to 7"
    )
  ) |>
  count(route, name = "n") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), route = reorder(route, share))
udfa_share <- n_udfa / n_entry
```

*Expectation: undrafted free-agent entry rivals the draft as an NFL route.* ✅

The table and the first figure split the `r fmt(n_entry)` NFL entries by
route and name the route each running example took, showing the undrafted
route alone carries `r pct(udfa_share)` of entrants, more than all seven
rounds combined; the second figure follows the route mix by draft class.

```{r}
#| label: routes-table
routes |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  transmute(
    Route = as.character(route),
    Entrants = fmt(n),
    Share = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "NFL entrants by entry route.")
```

```{r}
#| label: examples
cast <- c(
  "Joe Burrow",
  "Cameron Ward",
  "Jordan Travis",
  "Shane Buechele",
  "Kyle Allen"
)
examples <- risk |>
  filter(player %in% cast, outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    Route = if_else(
      outcome_drafted_d,
      sprintf(
        "Drafted, round %d, pick %d",
        outcome_draft_round_d,
        outcome_draft_pick_d
      ),
      "Undrafted free agent"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(draft_year) |>
  select(
    Player = player,
    `Final college season` = season,
    `Draft class` = draft_year,
    Route,
    `Eligible season` = eligible_season_index
  )
kable(
  examples,
  caption = "The running examples at their NFL entry. Eligible season counts the player's draft-eligible college seasons from one."
)
```

### 3.3 Most eligible seasons end with the player coming back, not with an outcome

```{r}
#| label: status
#| include: false
status_tab <- risk |>
  count(status_end_of_season, name = "seasons") |>
  mutate(
    share = seasons / sum(seasons),
    # Reader-facing labels for the statuses defined in Section 2.
    status_label = dplyr::recode(
      status_end_of_season,
      "continuing" = "Still playing next season",
      "exhausted_undrafted" = "Exhausted eligibility undrafted",
      "left_data" = "Left the data early",
      "signed_udfa" = "Signed as an undrafted free agent",
      "drafted" = "Drafted"
    ),
    status_label = reorder(status_label, share)
  )
st <- function(s) status_tab$share[status_tab$status_end_of_season == s]
```

*Expectation: exhausted eligibility is the most common end-of-season status.*
❌

The table and the first figure give the share of eligible seasons ending in
each status: `r pct(st("continuing"))` end with the player simply coming
back, ahead of the `r pct(st("exhausted_undrafted"))` that end with
eligibility exhausted; the second figure splits the statuses by eligible
season.

```{r}
#| label: status-table
status_tab |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  transmute(
    Status = as.character(status_label),
    Seasons = fmt(seasons),
    Share = pct(share)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Eligible player-seasons by end-of-season status.")
```

```{r}
        eligible_season_index,
        status_label,
        100 * share,
        fmt(n),
        fmt(seasons)
      ),
      data_id = paste(eligible_season_index, status_label)
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Coming back dominates early; exhausted eligibility dominates late",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible seasons by end-of-season status, by eligible season",
    x = "Eligible season (1 = first season the player could be drafted after)",
    y = "Share of eligible seasons (%)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted. Hover a segment for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
girafe(ggobj = p_status_idx, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: status-pin
#| include: false
top_status <- status_idx |>
  group_by(eligible_season_index) |>
  slice_max(share, n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
stopifnot(
  # the eligible-season figure's title
  all(
    top_status$status_end_of_season[top_status$eligible_season_index <= 2] ==
      "continuing"
  ),
  all(
    top_status$status_end_of_season[top_status$eligible_season_index >= 3] ==
      "exhausted_undrafted"
  ),
  abs(sum(status_tab$share) - 1) < 1e-8,
  st("continuing") > 0.45,
  st("exhausted_undrafted") > 0.3,
  st("continuing") > st("exhausted_undrafted"),
  st("left_data") > 0.05,
  abs(st("drafted") + st("signed_udfa") - p_entry) < 1e-8
)
```

### 3.4 The chance of entry rises with each eligible season a player waits

```{r}
#| label: hazard
#| include: false
hazard <- risk |>
  group_by(eligible_season_index) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    across(
      c(outcome_drafted_d, outcome_signed_udfa_d, outcome_nfl_entry_d),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(seasons >= 100)

hazard_long <- hazard |>
  select(
    eligible_season_index,
    seasons,
    Drafted = outcome_drafted_d,
    `Undrafted free agent` = outcome_signed_udfa_d,
    `NFL entry` = outcome_nfl_entry_d
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(eligible_season_index, seasons),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "p"
  )
hz <- function(k, col = "outcome_nfl_entry_d") {
  hazard[[col]][hazard$eligible_season_index == k]
}
```

*Expectation: the chance of NFL entry rises over a player's eligible
seasons.* ✅

The **hazard** is the chance that a player still unentered and still
playing at a given eligible season is taken by the very next draft; the
table and the first figure show it rising from `r pct(hz(1))` in the first
eligible season to `r pct(hz(4))` in the fourth, and the second figure
repeats it for three eras of draft classes.

```{r}
#| label: hazard-table
hazard |>
  transmute(
    `Eligible season` = eligible_season_index,
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    Drafted = pct(outcome_drafted_d),
    `Undrafted free agent` = pct(outcome_signed_udfa_d),
    `NFL entry` = pct(outcome_nfl_entry_d)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Per-season chance of each outcome by eligible season (eligible seasons with fewer than 100 player-seasons omitted)."
  )
```

### 3.5 The drafted share of eligible seasons has more than halved across draft classes

```{r}
#| label: trend
#| include: false
trend <- risk |>
  group_by(draft_year) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    drafted_ev = sum(outcome_drafted_d),
    entry_ev = sum(outcome_nfl_entry_d),
    drafted = drafted_ev / seasons,
    udfa = mean(outcome_signed_udfa_d),
    entry = entry_ev / seasons,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    entry_lo = wilson(entry_ev, seasons)["lo"],
    entry_hi = wilson(entry_ev, seasons)["hi"]
  ) |>
  ungroup()
tr <- function(y, col) trend[[col]][trend$draft_year == y]
y0 <- min(trend$draft_year)
y1 <- max(trend$draft_year)
```

*Expectation: NFL outcome prevalence is roughly stable across draft
classes.* ❌

The table and the first figure follow the drafted share from
`r pct(tr(y0, "drafted"))` of the `r y0` class to `r pct(tr(y1, "drafted"))`
of `r y1` while the pool of eligible seasons grew more than fourfold, with
NFL entry jumping at the 2016 class; the second figure shows the counts
behind those shares.

```{r}
#| label: trend-table
trend |>
  filter(draft_year %in% c(y0, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, y1)) |>
  transmute(
    `Draft class` = draft_year,
    `Eligible seasons` = fmt(seasons),
    Drafted = pct(drafted),
    `Undrafted free agent` = pct(udfa),
    `NFL entry` = pct(entry)
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Share of eligible seasons ending in each outcome, selected draft classes."
  )
```

### 3.6 Nearly half of NFL entrants play no games in their rookie season

```{r}
#| label: entry-year
#| include: false
entrants <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    games = outcome_rookie_games_entry_year,
    bin = cut(
      games,
      breaks = c(-1, 0, 4, 8, 12, 17),
      labels = c(
        "None (Travis, Buechele)",
        "1 to 4 (Allen)",
        "5 to 8",
        "9 to 12 (Burrow)",
        "13 to 17 (Ward)"
      )
    )
  )
games_tab <- entrants |>
  count(bin, name = "n") |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n), bin = factor(bin, levels = rev(levels(bin))))
made_roster <- mean(entrants$outcome_made_roster_entry_year)
zero_games <- mean(entrants$games == 0)
gm <- function(p) entrants$games[entrants$player == p]
```

*Expectation: most entrants appear on an NFL roster in their entry year.* ✅

Of the `r fmt(nrow(entrants))` entrants, `r pct(made_roster)` appear on an
entry-year NFL roster, yet the table and the first figure show
`r pct(zero_games)` played no regular-season game that year, with the
running examples placed in their bins; the second figure splits rookie
games by entry route.

## 4. Summary

The base rate a forecasting model has to beat is low and moving: four of
six expectations hold, and the two that fail show most seasons are
mid-career and the drafted share is falling.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tribble(
  ~Expectation                                      , ~Verdict , ~Evidence                                                                                                                    ,
  "The draft is rare, under 5% of eligible seasons" , "✅"      , sprintf("%s drafted; %s NFL entry by either route.", pct(p_drafted), pct(p_entry))                                           ,
  "Undrafted entry rivals the draft"                , "✅"      , sprintf("%s of entrants arrive undrafted.", pct(udfa_share))                                                                 ,
  "Exhausted eligibility is the most common status" , "❌"      , sprintf("%s of seasons end with the player returning; %s exhausted.", pct(st("continuing")), pct(st("exhausted_undrafted"))) ,
  "The entry chance rises with waiting"             , "✅"      , sprintf("From %s in the first eligible season to %s in the fourth.", pct(hz(1)), pct(hz(4)))                                 ,
  "Prevalence is stable across classes"             , "❌"      , sprintf("Drafted share %s (%d) to %s (%d).", pct(tr(y0, "drafted")), y0, pct(tr(y1, "drafted")), y1)                         ,
  "Most entrants make an entry-year roster"         , "✅"      , sprintf("%s on a roster, but %s play no game.", pct(made_roster), pct(zero_games))
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The base rate is not fixed.

- The drafted share fell by more than half across the data's span, so a model
  validated out of time is scored against rarer positives than it trained on.
- Calibration curves and precision at fixed recall say more across years than
  accuracy or raw discrimination figures.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Waiting time carries signal.

- The chance of entry varies about
  `r round(hz(4) / hz(1))`-fold over the eligible seasons, and the
  undrafted chance climbs faster than the drafted chance.
- Modeling drafted status alone discards that structure, and modeling entry
  without routes discards the competition between them.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Entry and playing are different questions.

- Nearly half of entrants play zero rookie games, so the second-stage labels
  (made roster, rookie games) are a separate prediction problem, not a
  footnote on the first.
:::

Several caveats bound these figures.

- The high-school graduation year is imputed for players without a
  recruiting record, `r pct(mean(risk$hs_year_imputed))` of eligible seasons
  including Burrow's and Ward's, and the imputation can mis-time redshirts
  and transfers, shifting rows in and out of the risk set.
- The "left the data early" status is informative censoring that the
  pipeline flags but does not resolve.
- The entry-year roster rate is partly mechanical: the undrafted link is
  defined by roster presence, so an undrafted entrant cannot fail it, and it
  reads better as a check on the link than as a finding.
- Two forces plausibly drive the drafted decline and the 2016 entry jump,
  though neither is tested here: the stat-line population grows faster than
  a draft of fixed size, and NFL roster coverage deepens over the years, so
  the undrafted lookup catches more signings that always happened.

```{r}
#| label: caveat-pin
#| include: false
stopifnot(
  all(risk$hs_year_imputed[risk$player %in% c("Joe Burrow", "Cameron Ward")])
)
```
